title: Outbreak: Foodborne Illness and the Struggle for Food Safety
lineage: Notes paraphrase selected source passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: The historian dates Straus’s New York infant-milk depot to summer 1893, describes subsidized milk and charitable coupons, and reports 34,400 bottles distributed in its first season. The count is bottles, not children served, and does not by itself prove a health effect.
